install_mujoco_vc_package: install the mujoco_vc Python package and its dependencies via pip using setup.py
review_setup_dependencies: review the install_requires list in setup.py to audit dependencies like mujoco-py mjrl and gym
refactor_setup_py: refactor the setup.py to add a console_scripts entry point or pyproject.toml configuration
summarize_package_metadata: summarize the mujoco_vc package metadata including name version and dependency list
test_package_install: test that pip install -e . works correctly and all install_requires resolve without error
